en: A black-and-white postcard image depicting a coastal Scandinavian village with wooden houses characterized by steep roofs and decorative woodwork. Rocky terrain surrounds the calm water, and a few boats or docks can be seen. The architecture features traditional Nordic elements and the landscape is rugged with minimal vegetation. The distinctive name 'Hällevikstrand' appears at the bottom left of the image, and a triangular insignia with the number '138' appears at the bottom right.
